span.p: [D3] Dynamic diagram: legacy down or file missing

1. No file from legacy:
alert, nothing else waits

5. Checks guests out;
non-pool checkouts by hand

7. Guest checked out:
cleaning as usual

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Views room photos; books a
room type or a specific room
on web or mobile.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Front desk (bookings,
check-in / out), hotel
manager, housekeeping
supervisor (cart queues).

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Phone and walk-in bookings,
check-in / out, room board,
cart queue panel.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frame: Rezerwacja +
room status. Source of truth
for room-nights; 10-min hold
until pre-auth.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frames: Housekeeping +
Servis tech. One cleaning and
repair queue, prioritised by
room needed-by.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frames: Visit +
Faraway. Check-in, checkout,
emergency list; smart-lock
adapter, mobile keys in MVP.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Board frame: Synchronizacja.
Only link to legacy: files
both ways every 15 min,
nightly comparison.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div:
Prices, non-pool stays,
settlement, refunds, reports.
No API, files only; blocks a
pool only we sell.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Hosted payment page; card
pre-authorisation at booking.
We never see card data.
